sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion at this exact site
sites.functional_impact_measured: cAMP-responsive luciferase assay in mammalian cells: GLP-1 potency at mycGLP-1R was not significantly different from wild-type GLP-1R (PMC6155907). SNAP-tagged constructs at the same junction showed normal agonist-induced internalisation dose-responses (PMC5913239) and normal raft partitioning (PMC6716783). CRISPR knock-in of SNAP-tag at the endogenous locus confirmed surface labelling of the receptor (PMC9849236).
sites.rationale: The signal peptide spans residues 1–23 (authoritative topology landmarks). A tag inserted after residue 23 (P) places it immediately before the mature extracellular N-terminus at residue 24 (R), which is the start of the large extracellular domain (24–143). Python computation confirms: seq[22]='P', seq[23]='R', and the nearest TM boundary (TM1, 144–168) is 120 residues away — far exceeding the ≥3-residue minimum. The myc-tag paper (PMC6155907) explicitly states the tag is 'directly downstream of the putative signal peptide', pinning the junction to insert_after_residue=23. Functional validation by cAMP assay (GLP-1 potency preserved) qualifies this as surface_and_function. Multiple independent groups using SNAP-tag, FLAG, and GFP at the same junction corroborate tolerance. The C-terminal YFP (PMC6155907) and C-terminal FLAG (PMC3973576, PMC9917595) were excluded because the C-terminus (residues 406–463) is intracellular. ECL3 amber-codon sites (PMC9175107: H374, R376, G377, T378) were excluded: H374 lies within TM6 (349–374); R376 is only 2 residues from TM6; G377 is only 2 residues from TM7 (379); T378 is only 1 residue from TM7 — none satisfy the ≥3-residue TM-distance constraint. The ICL3 cpGFP insertion (PMC10262203, K336–T343) is intracellular and excluded. The pEGFP-C3 construct (PMC2765688) places GFP upstream of the full GLP-1R sequence including its signal peptide; the relationship of the tag to SP cleavage is ambiguous and the position cannot be independently pinned, so it is treated as corroborating evidence for this site rather than a separate site. A myc-tag was inserted immediately downstream of the GLP-1R signal peptide (residues 1–23) in a full-length, membrane-anchored construct (mycGLP-1R) expressed in mammalian cells. Surface expression was confirmed and GLP-1 potency was assessed by a cAMP-responsive luciferase assay; potency was not significantly affected relative to untagged GLP-1R. The same junction (after SP cleavage, before mature residue 24) is independently supported by SNAP-tag knock-in at the endogenous locus by CRISPR/Cas9 (PMC9849236), stable SNAP-GLP-1R in MIN6B1 beta-cells (PMC6716783), SNAP-GLP-1R in CHO-K1 cells (PMC5913239), SNAP-tag + amber-codon dual-label constructs (PMC9175107), SNAP-flag-tagged GLP1R in INS-1 and HEK293T cells confirmed by FACS and ELISA (PMC11610247), and a FLAG-tagged full-length cryo-EM construct (PMC8748714). [validation: surface_and_function; position: inferred; source: paper; cited_tag_residue: 23; entailment_verified: True]

sources.claim: Introduction of a myc-tag to the N-terminus of GLP-1R immediately downstream of the putative signal peptide did not significantly affect the potency of GLP-1 at this receptor when assessed using a cAMP-responsive luciferase assay ( Figure 1 ).

literature_notes: Ledger entries considered and not proposed as separate sites: (1) C-terminal YFP (PMC6155907) and C-terminal FLAG (PMC3973576, PMC9917595) — the GLP-1R C-terminus (residues 406–463) is entirely intracellular per the authoritative topology; these tags are not on the extracellular face and are excluded. (2) ECL3 unnatural-amino-acid incorporation sites H374, R376, G377, T378 (PMC9175107) — ECL3 spans only residues 375–378 (4 residues); H374 is within TM6 (349–374); R376 is 2 residues from TM6 end; G377 is 2 residues from TM7 start (379); T378 is 1 residue from TM7 start — none satisfy the ≥3-residue TM-distance constraint required for a sterically plausible ~15–23 aa insert. Additionally, the amber-codon approach is a single-residue unnatural-aa substitution, not an epitope-tag insertion. (3) ICL3 cpGFP insertion between K336 and T343 (PMC10262203) — this loop is intracellular (topology: INTRACELLULAR 326–348) and is excluded. (4) pEGFP-C3 GFP-GLP-1R (PMC2765688) — GFP is fused upstream of the full GLP-1R sequence including its signal peptide; the tag's position relative to SP cleavage is ambiguous and insert_after_residue cannot be pinned independently; treated as corroborating evidence for Site 1. (5) HA-SP-FLAG-3C-GLP-1R construct (PMC8748714) — the FLAG is placed between a heterologous HA signal peptide and the GLP-1R coding sequence in an insect-cell cryo-EM construct; this is consistent with the N-terminal junction at residue 23 but uses a replaced signal peptide, so it is treated as additional corroboration rather than a separate site.
